close_reason: Renamed need_headers_injected to headers_implicit in both handlers
description: email.rs: the variable need_headers_injected appears verbatim in both handle_email_get and handle_email_parse with identical construction (lines 446-456 and 1805-1820). The name describes a mechanism ('inject') rather than the intent ('client requested dynamic header properties but did not explicitly request the raw headers list'). A clearer name is headers_implicit (or implicit_headers_fetch). The duplication itself is an elegance issue: both handlers share the same property-splitting and header-injection logic; extracting a prepare_header_props(properties) -> PreparedHeaderProps helper would eliminate the copy and give the concept a name.
title: need_headers_injected: duplicated logic with side-effect name
